_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Estimate fees versus impermanent loss

description: Estimate fees versus impermanent loss. Use this when the user gives numbers for a what-if and wants to know whether swap fees cover impermanent loss, gas, and exit cost. It needs no pool and reads no live data. Pass price_now, holding_days, and fee_apr_percent, for example price_now 2500, holding_days 14, fee_apr_percent 40. Add price_lower and price_upper for a concentrated range, or omit both for the full-range formula. Optionally pass price_later, capital_usd, gas_usd, and exit_cost_usd. Returns the formula, the fee fraction, the impermanent loss fraction, whether fees cover it and the costs you passed, a plain break-even price line, and break-even prices from a sample. It does not look up gas or recommend a position. To read a real pool's volume and fee APR, use check_pool.

capital_usd.description: Position size, so gas and exit cost can be turned into a fraction of the position

exit_cost_usd.description: Other exit cost. Not looked up

fee_apr_percent.description: Annualized fee APR in percent, not a fraction: 40 means 40%. For example the 1-day fee APR from check_pool

gas_usd.description: Gas you expect to pay. Not looked up

holding_days.description: How many days the fee APR is applied, a whole number from 1 to 365, such as 14

price_later.description: A later price to score. Omit to get break-even prices and the range edges only

price_lower.description: Lower bound of a concentrated range. Omit, with price_upper, for the full-range formula

price_now.description: Current price, quote token per base token, such as 2500 for ETH in USDC

price_upper.description: Upper bound of a concentrated range

name: estimate_lp

outputSchema.description: Bad input, such as a price of 0 or price_lower above price_upper, is refused with invalid_input and a message instead of this shape

break_even_prices.description: Later prices where the net result crosses zero, from a sample

fee_fraction.description: Expected fee income over the holding period, as a fraction of the position: 0.0153 means 1.53%

il_fraction_at_later.description: Impermanent loss at price_later as a negative fraction. null without price_later

in_range_now.description: Whether price_now is inside the range. null for the full-range formula

title: Estimate fees versus impermanent loss
